synopsis: DO-330 is presented as the DO-178C supplement or companion for qualifying software tools whose output is relied on without further checking [f7636, f14661, f15367]. The booklet places it within aerospace practice governing airborne software and evidence-producing tools, and lists it among standards and guides from several domains [f14653, f8154]. Crucially, tool qualification under DO-330 does not establish whether a physics model is valid [f7637, f14662, f15368]. The research did not verify DO-178C or DO-330, so its descriptions provide background rather than verified findings about those standards [f7633, f14664, f15369].
